items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: Julie Hooth was playing with her grand... Julie Hooth played guitar, I believe, banjo or guitar or something, yeah.

ctx.x: A few more questions because it's getting after 5 o'clock. I don't want to stay too late. But your sister, I read about her in Julie Huth, do you know that name? Oh, Julie Hooth. Julie Hooth. Who was she?

Well, she played with the band in Chicago too. Oh, I see. Oh wait, you see, Lucille at this time was in Europe, in Germany maybe. Julie Hooth was playing with her grand, I think around New York, and they cabled, what we could understand, they cabled Lucille to come back into New York and they were going on a job. Oh, I see. And the job was in Patterson, New Jersey, across the river, you know, and that's when they were at the rehearsal, coming from rehearsal, you see, the bus, we understand that a bus hit the call…
